description: This file defines a Timer class that measures elapsed time since the last event and triggers a callback if a specified duration has passed. It uses threading and synchronization primitives to manage timing and callback invocation.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class that tracks elapsed time since its last recorded event and calls a specified function when a set duration elapses.

methods.name: None __init__( self, duration: Union[int, float], call: Callable[[], None], )
methods.description: Initializes the Timer with a duration and callback function.

methods.name: None record_call(self)
methods.description: Records an event, starting or resetting the timer, and initializes background checking thread if not running.

methods.name: None quit(self)
methods.description: Signals the timer to stop checking and exit.

methods.name: None check(self)
methods.description: Runs in a background thread to periodically check if the timer has expired and invokes the callback if needed.
